description.value: This spell functions like Shadow Summoning , except that it duplicates any summoner, necromancer, or geomancer summoning spell that summons a creature or item of 2nd level or lower. The illusory summonings created deal one-fifth (20%) damage to nonbelievers, and non-damaging effects are 20% likely to work against nonbelievers.
